title: Armor True Legend 2: Eikon Chapter
originalTitle: 鎧正伝２　サムライトルーパー　英魂編（えいこんへん）
summary: A novelization of episodes 20-39 with more substantial departures, including Nasty family details, no Saranbo, different abductions and rescues, and a changed fate for the Warlords. The epilogue has Nasty decide to record the battle and name the five 'Samurai Troopers'.
